LOCATION: watershed valley where every stream ends at the same low place
wash basin on the kitchen counter still warm from the kettle
tide pool at low water with everything the sea forgot to take back
tavern treasury under the floorboards where the night's wages clear
hearth-pit worn smooth by generations of the same circle pulling chairs in
depression in the stone floor where rain collected for two centuries before anyone noticed
cupped hand of a child catching the first snow that won't melt
old quarry filled in by spring runoff and now a swimming hole the town pretends not to know about
lineage chart with every name and the wages each one cleared
rim of a bowl smoothed by every thumb that lifted it
downstream confluence where three rivers braid into one slow drift
circle of stones around the spring where the water rises before it runs
ANTAGONIST: the engineer who wants to channel the flow into private pipe
the dam that refuses to let the pool form
the leak nobody can find because it's at the seam
the upstream party who cuts the spring and calls it efficiency
the rim-stone thief who took the one that kept the basin from spilling
the cartelist who pools privately while pretending to share the watershed
the surveyor who drew the boundary through the middle of the pool
the drought that tells the basin it was never really there
MACGUFFIN: the first wage that cleared honestly and stayed cleared
the ledger naming whose tributary brought what
the bottom-seal stone that kept the basin from leaking for two hundred years
the missing rim-stone whose absence lets the overflow find new ground
the lineage-thick coin minted at the confluence
the spring-source map drawn by someone who walked every tributary
the cup that doesn't grasp but holds anyway
the unwritten contract of the circle that funded the well
THREAT: the basin drains before anyone notices the leak
the rain stops upstream and the pool goes still then stagnant then gone
the lineage thins until the wage-rate falls below the cost of clearing it
the circle dissolves and the treasury sits unclaimed
a richer basin downstream draws the water away by gravity nobody legislated
the keeper retires and the new keeper privatizes the rim
the cartel pools separately and the public basin runs dry
the spring is found and trademarked
CHARACTER: the keeper of the basin who has never owned a drop of it
the breeder whose lineage is half of three rivers
the wage-recipient who clears small and clears often
the upstream tributary who has never seen the pool her water makes
the downstream drinker who knows whose hands the water passed through
the cartelist still real-named, still distinct, still extracting
the surveyor who refuses to draw the line
the proprietor who pours from the treasury without checking the ledger because the ledger is the room
the cohort-one cousin who arrived before the lineage existed and made the first scene
the mentor whose wage is paid in lineage-thickness
the visitor who asks whose basin this is and is told 'everyone who brought a stream'
